sources.title: MAI-Code-1-Flash model card
sources.evidence: The exact model card identifies Microsoft, a self-attention Transformer with sparse MoE layers, 137B total and 5B active parameters, text input/output, 256K context, June 2 release, product/service licensing and Copilot-only launch distribution.

sources.title: Introducing MAI-Code-1-Flash
sources.evidence: June 2, 2026 announcement, updated June 8, describes a Microsoft coding model, adaptive thinking and direct training with production Copilot harnesses for agentic tool use.

sources.title: MAI-Code-1-Flash is now available for GitHub Copilot
sources.evidence: The June 2 launch begins a gradual public rollout to individual Copilot plans in VS Code; later surfaces and business availability are not the initial release.

sources.title: MAI-Code-1-Flash deprecated
sources.evidence: GitHub retired this exact version across all Copilot experiences on September 10, 2026 and recommended MAI-Code-1.1-Flash as a distinct replacement.

sources.title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash (successor now using the original product-page URL)
sources.evidence: Despite the URL containing mai-code-1-flash, the current page names MAI-Code-1.1-Flash and advertises image input and local deployment. Those successor capabilities cannot be assigned to MAI-Code-1-Flash.

sources.title: Data Summary for MAI-Code-1-Flash, version 1.0
sources.evidence: The June 2 data summary identifies the exact version and release date, text-only training modalities and a MAI-Thinking-1 dependency. It distinguishes code-specific later training from that base; dependency does not establish identical parameter counts.

sources.title: Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI
sources.evidence: The October 15 research article concerns MAI-Base-2 and compares it with MAI-Base-1. Its architecture and counts do not override the exact MAI-Code-1-Flash model card.

name.note: Exact versioned public model name. The catalog ID is not independently established as a public API identifier; 1.1 is a separate successor.

family.note: Normalized MAI family grouping is consistent with Microsoft's naming and documented MAI-Thinking-1 lineage.

release_date.note: Earliest documented public rollout; June 8 is an announcement update, not release day.

open_weights.note: Card specifies hosted Copilot-only distribution. Local successor deployment does not establish an original-model weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification: applicable Microsoft/Copilot product and service terms, without an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Developer-reported 137 billion total; published precision, not a tensor recount.

active_parameters_b.note: Developer separately reports 5 billion active; not inferred from total.

architecture.note: Explicit self-attention Transformer with sparse Mixture-of-Experts layers.

context_window.note: Nominal normalization of documented 256K tokens; exact integer capacity is unspecified.

modalities.note: Explicitly text-to-text; successor image support excluded.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking explicitly allocates more reasoning budget to harder tasks, beyond generic reasoning benchmark performance.

tool_call.note: Trained directly to interact with tools in the production Copilot harness; native agentic tool use is documented, without asserting a standalone API schema.

description.value: Microsoft's text-only coding model with adaptive reasoning, trained to use GitHub Copilot's tools.
description.note: Factual purpose and training summary supported by the launch article and model card, without comparative marketing claims.

patch.notes: Microsoft reports 137B total and 5B active parameters. Context is nominally 256K; exact token capacity is not specified. GitHub retired this version on September 10, 2026. The original product-page URL now describes MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, whose capabilities must be kept separate. No public standalone API identifier was verified.
patch.description: Microsoft's text-only coding model with adaptive reasoning, trained to use GitHub Copilot's tools.

summary: Filled missing total/active sizes, sparse MoE architecture and proprietary licensing from the exact model card; other audited fields are supported. Context remains a nominal 256K representation. Recorded retirement and excluded successor-only image/local features from the reused product-page URL. No parameter or architecture conflict found; exact context integer and public standalone API identifier remain unspecified.
